items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: John Joyce, JJ started playing with us.

ctx.x: I want to get the band, as it's changed now. Have you had any substitute drummers in since JJ started?

Well, the original drummer with the group was Bob McIntyre. And, well, a couple months back, Bob's wife had a baby. And, naturally, Bob had to give more time to his family, you know, and he couldn't get out the way he wanted to make these jobs at night. And, then, John Joyce, JJ started playing with us. And, from what I hear, I don't know, it might just be a rumor. But, JJ Joyce has won the Trap Drumming Championship at Mississippi State for about four years in a row. Now, I don't know how authentic that is, but…
